Class ResourcePlanetSyncManager

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.resource.ResourcePlanetSyncManager
public final class ResourcePlanetSyncManager extends Object

Resource Planet Sync Manager

Manages geophysical, thermodynamic, and ecological deductions derived from inherited planetary presets. Provides analytical scaling of continental biomass, soil carbon, aquifers, crustal metals, mantle heat, and terrain compatibility checks.

Since:
1.0.0
Author:
Ether Architectural Refactoring Engine
